itemized.notes: The 2026 Weber form is a DIFFERENT DOCUMENT from the 2012-2024 one: a typed 'Candidate Information' table, a 'Campaign Financial Summary' with Last Report / This Report / Cumulative Total columns, and a 'Filing Schedule (Check One)' list (May 26 - Pre-Primary Election ticked); the certification is signed and dated 5/26/2026 even though index.csv carries a blank filing date. Its Form A and Form B are NATIVELY LANDSCAPE pages - not rotated portrait sheets - so their geometry axis is 'y', unlike every earlier Weber schedule. This is a SCANNED document, NOT a Polimorphic born-digital e-filing: it has no text layer at all (pdftotext returns nothing over all three pages) and no 'Document generated with Polimorphic.com' footer, so it was vision-read as the brief directs. Redactions: the candidate's own street address and City/Zip on p1 and EVERY donor street address on p2 are BLACKED OUT BY THE COUNTY (government-applied, preserved, never recovered); the donor city/state/zip beside each bar remain printed and are what the donor_city / donor_state fields carry - so on this filing the blanks-that-aren't-there are the county's redaction, not filer omissions. No per-page SUBTOTAL, no in-kind row, no negative amount on either schedule.
